The two signals are complementary because one depends on the ordering of monthly extremes across time, while the other depends only on the latest bar's close position. Their raw directions are both negative, so aligning them by negation preserves the supplied directional information while producing a higher-is-better composite. This combination is expected to reduce noise through averaging two weakly correlated reversal signals.
